name: The Spirit Of Pride
overview: The Spirit of Pride is depicted in Scripture as a heart attitude that distances a person from God, as the wicked do not seek Him because of their proud countenance. Pride is condemned as hateful to the Lord and is linked to evil, arrogance, and contentiousness. It leads to shame and destruction, while wisdom is found in humility. The proud are described as an abomination to God and are certain to face consequences, highlighting the spiritual peril and judgment tied to pride.
